author: claude
summary: Follow-up to the same-day segment-inventory-done-status-mismatch fix: that fix was correct but scoped to the Activity page's SegmentRenderMonitor (useSegmentInventory.ts), NOT the chapter editor's inline per-segment ribbon the owner was actually looking at (CastTool/ScriptView, driven by useStudioChapter.ts). Owner report: resuming/continuing a partially-rendered chapter showed the already-black (done) text correctly at first, then the INSTANT the resumed job's first segment started pulsing, every previously-done segment turned gray. Root cause: useStudioChapter.ts's chapterRenderDoneSegmentIds was built only from the live active_segments_map's small rolling window (a handful of recently/currently-active segments), never from a segment's own persisted audio_status. The resumed job has no job.segment_ids (segment_ids: null), so chapterRenderQueuedSegmentIds falls back to its render_batches branch -- 'every span in the chapter minus rendering minus (live-window) done' -- which wrongly counted every segment finished in an EARLIER render as still queued the moment this memo recomputed for the new job. In ScriptView.tsx, isQueued wins over isReady/text-ready at equal CSS specificity, so the re-classified spans visibly re-dimmed to gray.

files.change: Added persistedDoneSegmentIds, derived from the segments prop's own audio_status/audio_file_path (same check style already used by chapterRenderPendingSegmentIds). chapterRenderDoneSegmentIds now unions this persisted set with the live active_segments_map's done-phase entries, instead of being sourced from the live map alone.

Added a hoisted mutable `segments` override on the useChapterEditor mock (mirroring the existing scriptViewData override pattern) and a new regression test reproducing the exact resume scenario: job.segment_ids null, two persisted-done segments outside the live map's window, one genuinely rendering, one genuinely still queued.

tests_added: frontend/tests/unit/pages/Book/studio/useStudioChapter.test.tsx::does not re-gray already-rendered segments from a PRIOR render when resuming without job.segment_ids (2026-07-13 fix)
revert_checked: Reverted chapterRenderDoneSegmentIds to its pre-fix live-map-only definition: the new test failed (chapterRenderDoneSegmentIds.has('S0') was false) for exactly the reported reason; restored the fix and all 18 tests in the file passed.
sibling_verification: Ran the full Book + ChapterEditor unit suite (56 files, 395 tests) after the change -- all green, including the pre-existing 2026-07-07 done/pending/queued regression tests this change extends the definition of chapterRenderDoneSegmentIds for.
eta_impact_checked: Owner specifically asked whether this would confuse ETA math. Grepped chapterRenderDoneSegmentIds's only 5 usages in this file (its own definition, chapterRenderPendingSegmentIds, chapterRenderQueuedSegmentIds x2, and the hook's return value) -- none touch progress/ETA computation. ETA comes from the backend's job.eta_seconds/eta_basis/confidence fields untouched by this change; also confirmed frontend/src/utils/chapterRenderProgress.ts and frontend/src/hooks/useAnimatedSegmentProgress.ts (the actual progress/ETA math) do not reference this set at all.
related_but_separate: docs/code-map/queue/2026-07-13-segment-inventory-done-status-mismatch.json -- same symptom class (live-window vs persisted-done), different component/surface, fixed earlier the same day. Two independent fixes were needed because the Activity page and the chapter editor each maintain their own separate 'is this segment done' derivation.
